column1: # The companies behind well-known networks (ADR 0036, decision 4): Watch names a flow that only its network names
# after the company of entities.tsv, and says whether that network also hosts other companies' servers. One row per
#   hosting          yes: the company sells cloud, CDN or hosting services, so a server there may be another company's
#                    and Watch names the network, not the service; no: the company sells none
#   registry         the AS name and organisation as the registry's RDAP record shows them, "NAME / Organisation"
#   link-source      a page linking the registry's organisation to the entity, or '-' when the names match
#   hosting-source   the company's page showing its hosting services, or its own network (no), or '-'
#   checked          the date the sources were read
